name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
label: Quest
description: Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge has a spare copy of Yagyin's Digest and will part with it for three items of power. Gerrig will not speak their names aloud…
intro: Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge has a spare copy of Yagyin's Digest and will part with it for three items of power. Gerrig will not speak their names aloud, and writes them down in a note instead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yagyin's Digest, eh? Are you starting a new chapter of us, somewhere? Never mind, it is not my place to ask.
I will help you, for I have an extra copy. We must aid each other, yes? That is how we flourish.
I require three items of power. Bring them to me and I will give you the digest.
I will not speak their names. Ears may be on us. But here, I will write them down.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the relics for which I asked?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are resourceful, adventurer. If it truly is your charge to begin a new chapter of our order, then I believe you will run it well.

sources.title: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)
